lines.text: The root is Aud! Auditorium, audit.
Quick quiz! Which means a hearing of accounts?
Audit! It means a hearing of accounts.

words.ex: The keynote speech will be in the main auditorium.
If you just want to learn the material, you could audit the class instead.
